newsitem.title: GERMANY: Munich Re hopes to open Brazil office in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Munich Re hopes to open Brazil office in 1997.

text.p: German reinsurance group Muenchener Rueckversicherungs AG, the world's largest, said on Wednesday it planned to open an office in Brazil as soon as market liberalisation laws allowed.
Spokesman Christian Jacobi confirmed in a telephone interview that the group, known as Munich Re, was already in contact with Brazilian authorities on its plans.

"We are expecting to be able to go ahead sometime during next year. Until now the state monopoly has prevented us from doing business in Brazil but the constitution has been changed, and we are now just waiting for the implementing regulations," Jacobi said.
Jacobi added that Munich Re had been observing the Brazilian market for many years and had many contacts there.
